conical_dropout_preprocessing.detection: row-wise grayscale closing residual; adaptive seed/grow thresholds from the robust second-difference noise scale
conical_dropout_preprocessing.acceptance: candidate must contain a strong seed, have bounded per-row width, and retain both X-direction shoulders
conical_dropout_preprocessing.replacement: robust local quadratic fitted to the surrounding base ring; only upward corrections to raw Z are allowed

height_sign: removal depth = robust reference plane - measured height

longitudinal_end_trimming.reference: median P95 depth in the central configured core
longitudinal_end_trimming.smoothing: centered rolling median of longitudinal profile depth
longitudinal_end_trimming.acceptance: central contiguous run within the maximum of 3*MAD, 12% of reference depth, and 0.25 um
longitudinal_end_trimming.outputs: stable start/end, effective length, and full-versus-effective volume
longitudinal_end_trimming.fallback: flag for review; fragmented/discrete lines are not treated as stable plateaus

width: median threshold-crossing width; crater perpendicular span in discrete mode
depth: median of per-profile/per-crater P95 removal depth
warning: Pilot outputs require visual review before 120-group batch processing.
